Package com.siemens.pki.cmpracomponent.configuration

Interface SharedSecretCredentialContext

All Superinterfaces:
CredentialContext
All Known Implementing Classes:
OutputSharedSecretCredentials
public interface SharedSecretCredentialContext extends CredentialContext
an instance implementing SignatureCredentialContext provides all attributes needed for shared secret based CMP protection
